passages.text: Ctenidium molluscum is a species of moss belonging to the family Hypnaceae.
It is native to Eurasia and Northern America.

RECORDS. — Bescherelle (1882): Oued Djer; Sud d‘Oran. Bescherelle (1882), Jelenc (1955 a): Édough; Gorges de la Chiffa; Oued Merdja. Trabut (1887 a): D‘Oran à Mécheria. Jelenc (1953, 1967): Kabylie des Babor, crête du Tababor, 1950 m. Jelenc (1955 a): Atlas de Blida; Crêtes du Djurdjura, Aït Ouaban; Hauts-plateaux oranais. Boukhatem et al. (2017): El-Kala National Park, Tonga lake watershed. Frequent.
